office_does: The three fire commissioners would be the first board of the proposed Rimrock Meadows fire district, running its fire protection and emergency services and setting its property tax levy; they take office only if voters form the district.
race_blurb: The only contested seat on the proposed district's first board. Longtime Rimrock Meadows property owner Ron Cabral, a first-time candidate, faces Carol Mayer, a neighboring wheat farmer, former Rimrock Meadows board member who describes more than 25 years at Grant County PUD.

candidates.summary: Rimrock Meadows property owner of 15 years with a background in transportation, logistics, fabrication and marketing, running for office for the first time.
highlights: Wants to give Rimrock Meadows 'representation and professional Fire protection' [S1]
Would draw on county, state, federal and grant funding to build the district [S1]
Says he led a campaign to restore the state ferry Puyallup [S1]

candidates.summary: Farms next to Rimrock Meadows, served about eight years on its board, and spent more than 25 years at Grant County PUD, including as clerk of the board and senior supply-chain manager.
highlights: Calls a formal fire district 'essential' for consistent emergency response [S1]
Cites procurement, regulatory-compliance and auditing experience from Grant County PUD [S1]
Lived at Rimrock Meadows for 23 years and still owns a lot there [S1]
